Card Q&A.a: No. If you have cards that are targets of this effect, you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.
Card Q&A.q: If the cards I reveal from my deck for this card's effect include both a green Digimon card and a green Tamer card, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining cards at the bottom of my deck?

Effect: [Main] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 green Digimon card and 1 such Tamer card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, place this card in the battle area.
・ You may play 1 [Terriermon] or [Lopmon] from your hand without paying the cost.
Security Effect: [Security] Suspend 2 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, place this card in the battle area.
